headline: 13 core Liquity V1 protocol and token contracts discovered on Ethereum mainnet

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Liquity' surfaced 7 core protocol contracts: BorrowerOperations (0x24179CD8...), TroveManager (0xa39739ef...), StabilityPool (0x66017d22...), ActivePool (0xDf9Eb223...), PriceFeed (0x4c517d4e...), HintHelpers (0xE84251b9...), SortedTroves (0x8fdd3fbf...)
No dedicated 'Deployed contracts' doc found on main website; GitHub README contains full system architecture and contract descriptions at https://github.com/liquity/dev
Trail of Bits audit (2021) and Coinspect audit (2021) reviewed; audit PDFs identify in-scope contracts but address listings embedded in repository rather than standalone deployment table

GitHub repository https://github.com/liquity/dev contains deployment helpers and migration scripts in packages/contracts/migrations/ and deployments/ folders; primary contract list sourced from verified Etherscan tags and code repository
D5: Liquity V1 operates only on Ethereum mainnet per protocol specification; no multi-chain deployments in scope
No factory-pattern contracts identified in core Liquity V1 system; system uses fixed set of core contracts with no dynamically created child contracts

All identified addresses classified with appropriate role taxonomy: core protocol contracts (borrower_operations, trove_manager, stability_pool, etc.), token contracts (token), and pool contracts (pool)
All admin_addresses[] entries trace to fetched Etherscan URLs with verified contract source code and role-indication in contract names

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice walk of Liquity V1 yielded 13 contracts across Ethereum mainnet: 7 core protocol contracts, 2 token contracts (LUSD, LQTY), and supporting contracts. Etherscan name-tag search and GitHub repository served as primary sources. No multi-chain deployments or factory-pattern contracts in V1 scope.

protocol_metadata.about: Liquity V1 is a decentralized collateralized debt protocol allowing users to borrow LUSD stablecoin against ETH collateral at 0% interest. The protocol features a 110% minimum collateral ratio, algorithmic stabilization through redemptions, and a two-tiered liquidation mechanism combining Stability Pool deposits with redistribution. LQTY governance token holders earn protocol fee revenue from issuance and redemption fees.
